name: processor
description: Processor v7.1 (W-trigger detector reads green, was dead on red): memory cell with set/reset trigger write (zero-write capable). Cell holds on red loop while green is 0; write = trigger latch (21) injects the value product onto the output loop while the reset pulse on green clears the old hold. Inputs: write_adress+write_value (encoded path, same timing as v6) or direct write_value(16)/write_trigger_set(15)/write_trigger_reset(18). Loop wires green (closed) and program-port wire included in the master. Architecture notes: modules/processor.design.md
